# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server log lines under the --save-turret client.
# map mp_carentan, g_gametype probe_turret (whose main() calls
# maps\mp\gametypes\dm::main()), probe_teleport 1, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults, two clients: client 0 a
# --probe-team axis net-probe standing as the target, client 1 the
# --save-turret gunner (allies). Captured 2026-09-25. The evidence is the
# server's own games_mp.log: the gametype is
# crates/gsc/tests/fixtures/semantics/client-probes/probe_turret.gsc, which
# logs every misc_mg42 and every placement it makes; the D; and K; records are
# the stock dm script's own. The client half of the same run is
# mp_carentan-dm-turret.txt beside this file.
#
# Three shells, the gsc probe first:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PROBE_SECS=230 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --probe-team axis --probe-secs 180
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --save-turret --probe-secs 170
# The axis client started 15 s after the server and the gunner 5 s after it.
# The gunner's placement, 40 units behind the gun, took the mount on the first
# tap; no spot was moved.
#
# PROBE turret <num> <origin> <angles>: a misc_mg42 at the startup census.
# PROBE place <clientNum> <team> <origin> <yaw>: a probe_teleport move.
# D;<victimNum>;<team>;<name>;<attackerNum>;<team>;<name>;<weapon>;<damage>;<mod>;<hitloc>
# K; the same fields for the killing hit.
# Lines are copied from games_mp.log with the engine's m:ss stamp, leading
# padding trimmed;
# every PROBE, D; and K; line of the run is here and nothing else.
